edition.title: The Daily Daedalus
edition.tagline: One reader. One editor. No filler.

desks.label: Cluster & Infrastructure
topics: Kubernetes node health, current pod failures, and rollout state across every live namespace
GPU Operator device plugin, DCGM, NFD, driver and library compatibility, and allocation failures
Flux reconciliation, drift, and relevant recent fleet-repository changes
UniFi controller, adopted devices, active clients, WAN state, pending adoptions, and material firmware notices
Synology storage health and the rsync mirror to /volume2/daedalus/datasets/cluster-maintenance/
rules: Lead every normal edition with current verified state from this desk.
Prioritize active failures, degradation, rollout risk, drift, pressure, and action over routine healthy counts.
Treat cumulative events and prior failure-rate examples as history unless live resources remain degraded.
Report the current namespace count and coverage scope instead of assuming a remembered count of 25.
Never carry a previous cluster statistic, namespace count, incident, or rsync condition forward without a current check.

desks.label: Weather
topics: Current conditions for Saline, Michigan
The next three complete calendar days
rules: Show today plus a three-day outlook in a compact, comparable format.
Call out only consequential precipitation, wind, temperature, visibility, or severe-weather changes.

desks.label: Email & Calendar
topics: Recent Gmail threads that require action or materially change plans
Google Calendar events for today and the next three calendar days
rules: Summarize only important or actionable mail; include why it matters.
Separate today's agenda from the three-day look-ahead.
Do not expose unnecessary private message or attendee details.

desks.label: AI & Inference Desk
topics: LLM inference engineering in vLLM, SGLang, Triton, Dynamo, NIXL, benchmarks, throughput, and latency
NVIDIA NIM, NVCF, DSX, CUDA, drivers, Spectrum-X, BlueField, and the wider NVIDIA stack
GPU scheduling on Kubernetes, including HAMi, KAI Scheduler, LeaderWorkerSet, gang scheduling, and MIG
NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit and the Daedalus project, including releases, relevant issues, and implementation progress
rules: Prefer changes that affect the reader's real build and operating work.
Do not recap unchanged product marketing or low-signal benchmark claims.

desks.label: Science & Technology
topics: Research signals in LLM training, inference, robotics, and optimization
AI infrastructure partnerships, data-center buildouts, and competing systems stacks
rules: Select research for practical consequence, not academic novelty alone.
Include industry moves only when they change the strategic or technical landscape.

desks.label: Markets & Finance
topics: Seasonal personal-finance fundamentals, including savings rate, tax-advantaged accounts, index mechanics, and behavioral guardrails
Occasional macro context when a structural shift affects long-term planning
rules: No daily market recap, ticker tape, stock tips, trading hype, or fear headline.
A quiet ledger line is the normal result when no durable or seasonal item is timely.

desks.label: Outdoors & Field
topics: Seasonal bird activity, migration alerts, notable sightings, and eBird trends around Saline, Ann Arbor, and Washtenaw County
Photography fieldcraft, post-processing, and seasonal outing ideas with Alicia
Southeast Michigan weather interpreted for shooting conditions, place, and timing
rules: Favor field usefulness and seasonal specificity over generic nature copy.
Avoid gear churn; recommend equipment only when it solves a concrete field problem.
Reuse verified forecast facts from the Weather desk instead of researching a duplicate forecast.

desks.label: Sports
topics: New York Yankees scores, standings, schedule, and an optional WFAN listen link on game days
Pittsburgh Steelers scores, standings, schedule, and material team news
Michigan State men's football
Michigan State men's basketball
rules: Report scores, standings, upcoming games, and genuinely consequential news without filler.
Do not manufacture offseason coverage for a team with no material update.
Include a WFAN link only when it is useful and verified for the game-day context.

desks.label: Culture & Leisure
topics: Vegetarian recipes, cooking technique, seasonal ingredients, and exceptional Saline or Ann Arbor restaurant ideas
Electronic, rock, and classical releases or performances with the listening time commitment stated
Science fiction and media in the orbit of Star Trek and The X-Files, including shared viewing ideas with Alicia
rules: Choose things worth the reader's downtime, not entertainment-industry churn.
Skip broad restaurant-scene coverage outside the local area.
